text:
Alyssa: Quick heads up — I'm seeing a ~$45k mismatch between the prepaid Dedicated invoices posted this month and our revenue schedule for Q1. Figured I'd flag here before close-week adjustments.

Maria: Can you paste the invoice IDs and the schedule rows? rough amount and period is fine.

Alyssa: Paste from billing export:
```
INV-2026-1456, customer: Acme, billed: 2026-02-25, total: 150000, prepaid_term_months: 12, deferred_monthly: 12500
INV-2026-1499, customer: Bolt, billed: 2026-03-03, total: 60000, prepaid_term_months: 6, deferred_monthly: 10000
```
Our revenue schedule shows Acme deferred 12x @12500 OK; Bolt shows 6x @9000 (should be 10000) — delta = 1k/month * 6 months = 6k. Combined with a stray manual adjustment in March (-39k) gives ~45k gap.

Kevin: Hmm. Where did the -39k manual adjustment come from? any JE ref or who posted it?

Alyssa: It's tagged in the billing system as `manual_allocation_2026-03-15` by user `revenue_ops` (I think Kevin's automation runs under that account). Link to export: https://redwood-internal.sheets/s/prepay-recon-03

Kevin: That's my automation for migrating older prepaid splits when customers request proration. I remember a special case for Bolt last month where we applied a promo credit and my script created an adjustment. I should have left a note. Sorry.

Priya: For month-end we need: 1) reconciliation file with invoice_id, billed_amount, deferred_balance, schedule_id, 2) recommended JE (debit/credit + GL accounts), 3) owner for approval. Can we get that before 2pm PT so Sam can sign off?

Alyssa: I'll assemble the reconciliation CSV and mark the rows where schedule != expected. Sample row I'm adding to the sheet:
```
invoice_id,customer,period,expected_monthly,deferred_on_schedule,delta
INV-2026-1499,Bolt,2026-03,10000,9000,1000
```

Kevin: I'll add a note to the script and create a small rollback JE suggestion:
```
DR Deferred Revenue (GL 2102) 45,000
CR Unearned Promo Liability (GL 2199) 45,000
```
This will net out the accidental manual reduction.

Sam: Please include supporting docs for each line (invoice PDF + billing export + script log). I can approve the JE once I see the backup. Also confirm the timing: do we book the correction in March close or spread it forward?

Priya: Recommend one-time correction in March close to keep schedule aligned. Spreading would misstate performance this quarter.

Alyssa: Uploaded invoices + billing export + the script log snippet to the sheet (see link) and pinned the rows. I also tagged @sam.

Sam: OK reviewing now. If everything matches, I'll approve the JE and sign. Kevin — please stop the automation temporarily for that customer until fix is deployed (ticket #TICK-4821).

Kevin: Pausing automation for Bolt and running a dry-run of the fix. I'll post the updated script diff to the ticket.

Alyssa: Thanks — I'll update the close checklist and include the JE reference.

Sam: Approved contingent on the attachments matching. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Noted — I'll update the revenue schedule post-JE and throw an alert to accounting watchers.

Alyssa: Closing the loop here — we booked the one-time correction in March JE and schedules now match. Will follow up with a short RCA on why the promo proration didn't set the expected deferred amount.

Kevin: RCA will include test for promo credits to ensure future proration uses billed_amount net of credits. Will link the PR when ready.
